design_gotchas.title: Weak ±5 mA Output Drive and 350 kHz / 0.16 V/µs Speed Limit vs Pin-Identical TLV9001/TLV9061
design_gotchas.detail: OPA333AIDBVR shares the exact TI DBV SOT-23-5 pinout (1=OUT, 2=V-, 3=+IN, 4=-IN, 5=V+) with TLV9001IDBVR (40 mA, 1 MHz) and TLV9061IDBVR (50 mA, 10 MHz), but delivers only ±5 mA short-circuit current, 2 kΩ open-loop output impedance, 350 kHz GBW, and 0.16 V/µs slew rate. Strictly for low-frequency DC precision—not fast signals or heavy loads.

design_gotchas.title: Chopper Auto-Calibration Input Bias Pulses Require Balanced Low Source Impedance
design_gotchas.detail: Internal auto-calibration chopping yields ±70 pA typ (±200 pA max) pulsed input bias current rather than sub-pA static CMOS bias. Keep source resistances balanced and modest (<10 kΩ) or add differential RC filtering to prevent chopper current rectification errors.

design_gotchas.title: SOT-23-5 (DBV) vs SC70-5 (DCK) Pinout Reversal Inside Same Datasheet
design_gotchas.detail: OPA333AIDBVR (5-pin SOT-23) places OUT on Pin 1 and +IN on Pin 3, whereas OPA333AIDCKR (5-pin SC70) puts +IN on Pin 1, -IN on Pin 3, and OUT on Pin 4 (page 3). Never carry over pin numbers when shrinking from DBV to DCK.

design_gotchas.title: Strict ±1 mA Signal Input Current Abs Max and Seebeck Thermal EMF Sensitivity
design_gotchas.detail: Absolute Maximum Ratings specify ±1 mA signal input current (page 5), and achieving true 10 µV offset accuracy requires symmetric PCB copper layout shielded from air currents and heat sources to prevent thermocouple (Seebeck) voltages >0.1 µV/°C (page 12).

typical_use_cases: Thermocouple, RTD, bridge load-cell, and precision electronic scale front-ends
Battery-powered handheld instrumentation needing 17 µA Iq and 10 µV max offset
Low-side micro-volt shunt current sensing with zero 1/f flicker noise (1.1 µVPP 0.1–10 Hz)
High-linearity 16-bit to 24-bit sigma-delta ADC buffers requiring 130 dB crossover-free CMRR
engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments OPA333AIDBVR is an ultra-low-power (17 µA typ), zero-drift auto-calibrated RRIO CMOS operational amplifier in a 5-pin SOT-23 (DBV) package operating from 1.8 V to 5.5 V (-40°C to 125°C). It achieves industry-leading DC precision—10 µV max input offset, 0.05 µV/°C max drift, 130 dB crossover-free CMRR, and 1.1 µVPP 0.1–10 Hz noise with zero 1/f flicker. While pin-for-pin identical in SOT-23-5 (DBV) to TLV9001IDBVR and TLV9061IDBVR, its 350 kHz GBWP, 0.16 V/µs slew rate, and ±5 mA output limit confine it strictly to precision low-frequency DC measurement.
